name: Sphere-Voxel Collision Detection via Displacement Averaging
definition: A collision detection method for a sphere moving through a voxel grid. It calculates a displacement vector representing the push-out needed to resolve penetration by averaging displacements from all intersected voxel faces.
summary: Sphere-Voxel Collision Detection via Displacement Averaging calculates a continuous push-out vector by averaging displacements from intersected voxel faces, differing from boolean tests by enabling physical resolution of penetration.
